scope: Worker orchestration and real private filesystem compensation with an injected renderer only in processor unit tests. This is not evidence of an encoded preview.
publication_coverage: verified output promoted exclusively with mode 0400 and stored checksum/size
existing canonical preserved without adoption or overwrite
invalid source hash, permissions or absence stops processing
invalid output hash, escaped path or symlink cannot publish
encoding failure cleans only the current workspace
lease lost after link leaves canonical intact and does not complete
uncertain commit reply preserves the canonical even when the database committed
test_isolation_fixes: Historical worker test restores root logging handlers/level after configure_logging so a closed pytest capture stream cannot affect a later test.
The descendant test treats disappearance of /proc stat as successful observed termination instead of an assertion race.
production_wiring: main retains startup diagnostics and signal handlers, then explicitly constructs PreviewProcessor and PreviewWorker. The processor defaults to the actual FFmpeg renderer; no dummy production processor.
real_preview_integration: Not executed by this agent; coordinated root HTTP/Chromium acceptance is the separate real-media proof.
